reason: Conversation 1 asked the right questions (clean or dirty water, how much), got the answers, and correctly reassured the homeowner in two turns that a cupful of clean water in the sump is normal and no part or repair is needed. Conversation 2 reached the same conclusion only after sending the homeowner on an unnecessary impeller check and a drain test. It also contained a blank list step (acknowledged), a confusing instruction to unplug and then plug back in, and a typo ('puddge') with another blank list item in the final message. It did not make unsupported fault claims in the end, but it was much less efficient and less clear.
